<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Something Big Is Coming</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#000;overflow:hidden}
  /* Fixed 1920x1080 design stage, scaled to fit any landscape TV (4K, FHD, HD) */
  #stage{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:1920px;height:1080px;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--s,1));transform-origin:center center;
    background:url("data:image/png;base64,") center/100% 100% no-repeat;
  }
  .num{
    position:absolute;height:55.4px;
    background:rgb(3,18,34);                 /* same fill as the original tiles */
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-family:Montserrat,"Segoe UI","Arial Black",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;
    font-size:55px;line-height:1;color:#fff;letter-spacing:1px;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 0 14px rgba(0,200,255,.25);
  }
  #d{left:612.5px;top:795.8px;width:148.4px}
  #h{left:792.7px;top:795.8px;width:149.2px}
  #m{left:974.5px;top:795.8px;width:148.4px}
  #s{left:1155.5px;top:795.8px;width:150.8px}
  .tick{animation:pop .25s ease-out}
  @keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(1.12)}to{transform:scale(1)}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="stage">
  <div class="num" id="d">02</div>
  <div class="num" id="h">12</div>
  <div class="num" id="m">45</div>
  <div class="num" id="s">28</div>
</div>
<script>
  // ===== LAUNCH DATE & TIME (Indian Standard Time) =====
  const LAUNCH = {
    day:    21,        // date of the month
    month:  "Oct",     // Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
    year:   2026,
    hour:   12,         // 1-12
    minute: 0,
    ampm:   "AM"       // "AM" or "PM"
  };
  // =====================================================
  const MONTHS = {Jan:1,Feb:2,Mar:3,Apr:4,May:5,Jun:6,Jul:7,Aug:8,Sep:9,Oct:10,Nov:11,Dec:12};
  const h24 = LAUNCH.hour % 12 + (LAUNCH.ampm.toUpperCase() === "PM" ? 12 : 0);
  const pad2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const TARGET = new Date(
    `${LAUNCH.year}-${pad2(MONTHS[LAUNCH.month])}-${pad2(LAUNCH.day)}T${pad2(h24)}:${pad2(LAUNCH.minute)}:00+05:30`
  );

  function fit(){
    const s=Math.min(innerWidth/1920, innerHeight/1080);
    document.getElementById('stage').style.setProperty('--s', s);
  }
  addEventListener('resize', fit); fit();

  const el={d:d,h:h,m:m,s:s}, pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  function render(){
    let diff=Math.max(0, TARGET - Date.now());
    const D=Math.floor(diff/864e5), H=Math.floor(diff/36e5)%24,
          M=Math.floor(diff/6e4)%60,  S=Math.floor(diff/1e3)%60;
    const v={d:pad(D),h:pad(H),m:pad(M),s:pad(S)};
    for(const k in v){ if(el[k].textContent!==v[k]){ el[k].textContent=v[k];
      el[k].classList.remove('tick'); void el[k].offsetWidth; el[k].classList.add('tick'); } }
  }
  render(); setInterval(render, 250);
</script>
</body>
</html>
